title: When waiting keeps turning bitter after the mind has slipped
issueStatement: Delay has started feeding resentment instead of ripening trust. The problem now is not only temptation or pain, but what to do after the slip has already happened.
centralInsight: Guru ties patience to listening, honor, and steadiness rather than passive resentment. Gurbani keeps repair close to remembrance, humility, and return instead of theatre.
practicalReflection: The mind settles less by roaming and more by right company. Wait by listening instead of simmering.
actionPrompt: Wait by listening instead of simmering. Choose the next truthful return instead of rehearsing the failure.
